findings.text: follow-on: test_short_completion_rolls_back_and_resumes claims to guard the done-when clause 'a completion under 200 tokens counts as a validation failure', but the 199 it installs is never read: the World validate stub at tests/test_agent_reload.py:107-114 short-circuits on valid_result, and the test also passes valid=lambda job: job != 'new-1' at line 166, so completion_tokens['new-1'] = 199 is dead and the assertion reddens at 250 all the same. The 200-token threshold lives only in the untested cli.py:2443 validate closure.

follow-on: reload.py:61 re-applies the profile-name predicate that cli.py:1273 _profile_jobs owns, so the cycle adds the fourth copy of that filter the plan explicitly forbade ('all three switch to the helper, so the cycle adds no fourth copy'); the injected read_jobs already returns only the selected job, so the filter is redundant as well as duplicated.

follow-on: peak is sampled only inside the drain loop (reload.py:100-102), which exits as soon as a measured zero is seen, so the recorded peak_held never counts the requests that accumulate during the replacement wait, which is the interval in which a pause actually holds the most; the lane reading is not consulted again for the rest of the cycle, so lane-cycles.jsonl systematically under-reports the peak the plan asks for ('poll router_generation_gate.waiting while paused and keep the peak').

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (312e77be feat, 15eaca6d refactor, 79d8e82a fix, 6423dad7 fix, 89748ecb docs); reload.py adds run_reload/ReloadResult/_utc_stamp, cli.py adds _profile_jobs/_pause_gate/_resume_gate/_execute_restart_cycle and rewires shutdown/key/restart, and the tests add the cycle, rollback, deadline and operator-pause checks.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's done-when names tests/test_agent_reload.py tests/test_agent_pause_cli.py tests/test_agent_dry_run.py tests/test_agent.py plus whole-tree ruff and the serving-interpreter parse check; final-delivery-gate.log records 233 passed/3 failed (EXIT=1), final-delivery-lint.log EXIT=0 and final-delivery-serving-parse.log EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the source brief.txt goal is to make agent restart swap the serving engine through a bounded paused cycle that never loses a request; imas_ambix/agent/reload.py:36 run_reload pauses, drains to a measured zero, cancels by id, submits, waits RUNNING/ready/validate and resumes in a finally, and imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2233 restart now gains only --reason and delegates.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries the base/head revisions, five commits, a readable baseline_suite whose log_digest sha256:9f1f4e1b63d7e5777237b513a0252f830abce6be24569aa383eedf42802e3c2b matches the on-disk base-three.log, an after_suite at 89748ecb naming final-delivery-gate.log, and the declared negative-control log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief grants imas_ambix/agent/reload.py, imas_ambix/agent/cli.py, tests/test_agent_reload.py, tests/test_agent.py, tests/test_agent_dry_run.py, ops/lane-cycle/AGENTS.md, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the 9d15b0e3..89748ecb diff changes exactly the first seven and writes no figure.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation reddens six cases in resumed-final-negative-control.log with EXIT=1, but tests/test_agent_reload.py:167's sub-200 completion value is short-circuited away by the World stub at tests/test_agent_reload.py:107-114, and cli.py:2443 validate and the _profile_jobs sharing carry no test.
justifications.evidence: final-delivery-gate.log's header names revision 89748ecb and the reviewed worktree and its last line is EXIT=1 with 233 passed/3 failed, the same three ids as the verified base-three.log, but resumed-final-negative-control.log is at revision 79d8e82a rather than the head and no gate asserts that shutdown and key --rotate select jobs through cli.py:1273 _profile_jobs.
justifications.fit: imas_ambix/agent/reload.py:16-25 uses the frozen-dataclass and injected-callable idiom of imas_ambix/agent/lane.py, _pause_gate/_resume_gate are now the single owners used by the pause and resume commands, and no added name carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/agent/reload.py:81-173 runs pause, a measured-zero drain, cancel-by-id, submit, RUNNING/ready/validation and the rollback, and imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2233 restart adds only --reason and --dry-run, but reload.py:61 re-adds the profile filter the plan forbade and reload.py:100 samples the peak only while draining.
justifications.reuse: imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:1273 _profile_jobs extends _running_jobs and cli.py:3712/3729 _pause_gate/_resume_gate are the shared owners the pause and resume commands now call, but imas_ambix/agent/reload.py:61 duplicates the _profile_jobs predicate rather than relying on the injected reader.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the 9d15b0e3..89748ecb diff (cli.py, reload.py, three test files, ops/lane-cycle/AGENTS.md, the evidence fragment) is inside the brief's declared write paths and cli.py:1106/1984/2298 switch to the one helper as required.
